item.title: Cabinet approves National Mission on Critical Minerals to secure supply chains
item.description:
The Union Cabinet approved a National Mission on Critical Minerals. The Mission will be implemented by the Ministry of Mines.

It covers exploration, processing and recycling of critical minerals.

item.title: Joint military exercise between India and Japan begins in Rajasthan
item.description: The joint military exercise between the Indian Army and the Japan Ground Self-Defense Force began today.
